intro: "Stinky" Ignatz is hemmed in by swamp critters and has not found the bogbean he came for. Mebok Mizzyrix, a goblin of Ratchet, wants bogbean leaves to brew a potion, and Ignatz asks you to get him out of this and watch over him while he searches. Afterward, Mebok Mizzyrix is to be found in Ratchet.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Great, finally something that doesn't want to eat me!!
I need help handling the critters around here, and you fit the mold, friend.
A goblin from Ratchet named Mebok Mizzyrix needs some bogbean leaves for a potion, or something... I honestly don't care why -- his money was good and I know this swamp, so here I am.
Too bad I got myself surrounded before I found the bogbean! Can you help me out of here, and watch my back as I look for Mebok's plant?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Stinky was here with the herbs I ask of him, and he told me you helped him out of a bind. Good work! A friend of Stinky's is a friend of mine!
He asked me to give you this if I ever saw you, right before he walked back south toward the marsh.
